title: 复刻 <choose>/<when>/<otherwise>、<set> 去尾逗号与 <trim> 通用修剪
expected_output:
choose type=A   : status = 0
choose type=B   : status = 1
choose type=Z   : 1 = 1
set render      : SET name = ?, email = ?
set full SQL    : UPDATE t_user SET name = ?, email = ? WHERE id = ?
set empty       : <no SET clause>
set empty ok    : false
trim where      : WHERE name = ? AND age > ?
trim set        : SET name = ?, age = ?
